mechanism_narrative: Persistent depression in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility reduces commuter and office-worker foot traffic, which directly lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain at or below their t-0w levels.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM beyond 2 points signals reduced essential errand activity that spills over into retail-and-recreation, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM falling more than 2 points week-on-week.
